metric_caveat: Gold evidence for a job is the evidence belonging to the single project the job was generated from. Item-level recall@k therefore REWARDS concentration: a retriever returning three views of the gold project scores higher than one returning the gold project plus four other relevant projects. project_hit@k and project_mrr are reported alongside because they ask the question the Proposal Writer actually depends on - did the right project reach the top k - without that bias. Both are reported; neither alone is the answer.

results.description: Naive dense: fixed chunks, top-k cosine over the whole job post
One retrieval per extracted requirement, merged with RRF
Hybrid BM25 + dense fused with reciprocal rank fusion
Views indexed separately, aggregated and returned one per project
Contextual prefixes on every chunk, hybrid retrieval over them
Hypothetical document embedding: retrieve with a generated ideal case study
Corrective RAG: grade retrieved evidence, re-query when weak, refuse when none
GraphRAG: traverse skills -> projects -> evidence, filtered by industry
